description: Agent CLIs of Chinese model makers, from their own installers: Kimi Code (Moonshot, kimi), Qwen Code (Alibaba, qwen) and MiniMax Code (MiniMax, mcode); no Node recipe needed

steps.name: Kimi Code from Moonshot's installer
steps.run: f=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/install.sh -o "$f" && bash "$f" < /dev/null; status=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $status

steps.name: Qwen Code from Alibaba's installer
steps.run: version=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors https://qwen-code-assets.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/releases/qwen-code/latest/VERSION) && version="v${version#v}" && case "$(uname -s)" in Darwin) target=darwin-arm64;; *) target=linux-arm64;; esac && d=$(mktemp -d) && base="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/releases/download/$version" && curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors "$base/SHA256SUMS" -o "$d/SHA256SUMS" && curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors "$base/qwen-code-$target.tar.gz" -o "$d/qwen-code-$target.tar.gz" && curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors https://qwen-code-assets.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/installation/install-qwen-standalone.sh -o "$d/install.sh" && QWEN_INSTALL_ARCHIVE="$d/qwen-code-$target.tar.gz" QWEN_INSTALL_VERSION="$version" bash "$d/install.sh" < /dev/null; status=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $status

steps.name: Build tools for MiniMax Code's SQLite module, when its prebuilt one cannot be had (Linux)
steps.run: [ "$(uname -s)" = Linux ] || exit 0; command -v make > /dev/null && command -v g++ > /dev/null && exit 0; apt-get -q -y update && apt-get -q -y install build-essential

steps.name: MiniMax Code from MiniMax's installer
steps.run: f=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/install.sh -o "$f" && bash "$f" < /dev/null; status=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $status

steps.name: kimi, qwen and mcode on every program's path
steps.run: home=$(eval echo "~$AGENT_VM_BOX_USER") && mkdir -p /usr/local/bin && ln -sfn "$home/.kimi-code/bin/kimi" /usr/local/bin/kimi && ln -sfn "$home/.local/bin/qwen" /usr/local/bin/qwen && rm -f /usr/local/bin/mcode && printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec "%s/.minimax-code/bin/mcode" "$@"\n' "$home" > /usr/local/bin/mcode && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/mcode

update.name: Kimi Code, the newest
update.run: latest=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/latest) && current=$(~/.kimi-code/bin/kimi --version 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$latest" ] && [ "$latest" = "$current" ] && { echo "Kimi Code $current is the newest"; exit 0; }; f=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors https://code.kimi.com/kimi-code/install.sh -o "$f" && bash "$f" < /dev/null; status=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $status

update.run: version=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors https://qwen-code-assets.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/releases/qwen-code/latest/VERSION) && version="v${version#v}" && { [ "${version#v}" != "$(~/.local/bin/qwen --version 2>/dev/null)" ] || { echo "Qwen Code ${version#v} is the newest"; exit 0; }; } && case "$(uname -s)" in Darwin) target=darwin-arm64;; *) target=linux-arm64;; esac && d=$(mktemp -d) && base="https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/releases/download/$version" && curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors "$base/SHA256SUMS" -o "$d/SHA256SUMS" && curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors "$base/qwen-code-$target.tar.gz" -o "$d/qwen-code-$target.tar.gz" && curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors https://qwen-code-assets.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/installation/install-qwen-standalone.sh -o "$d/install.sh" && QWEN_INSTALL_ARCHIVE="$d/qwen-code-$target.tar.gz" QWEN_INSTALL_VERSION="$version" bash "$d/install.sh" < /dev/null; status=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $status

update.name: Build tools for MiniMax Code's SQLite module, when its prebuilt one cannot be had (Linux)
update.run: [ "$(uname -s)" = Linux ] || exit 0; command -v make > /dev/null && command -v g++ > /dev/null && exit 0; apt-get -q -y update && apt-get -q -y install build-essential

update.name: MiniMax Code, the newest
update.run: f=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/install.sh -o "$f" && bash "$f" < /dev/null; status=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $status

update.name: kimi, qwen and mcode on every program's path
update.run: home=$(eval echo "~$AGENT_VM_BOX_USER") && mkdir -p /usr/local/bin && ln -sfn "$home/.kimi-code/bin/kimi" /usr/local/bin/kimi && ln -sfn "$home/.local/bin/qwen" /usr/local/bin/qwen && rm -f /usr/local/bin/mcode && printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec "%s/.minimax-code/bin/mcode" "$@"\n' "$home" > /usr/local/bin/mcode && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/mcode
